# Medieval Village MegaKit — Standard

Official source: https://quaternius.itch.io/medieval-village-megakit

176 glTF models extracted unchanged with their buffers and textures. This is the free Standard subset, not the full 300+ collection. Original CC0 terms are in `License_Standard.txt`.

Open models under `glTF/` in Godot. Original archive (including FBX/OBJ alternatives), publisher page and SHA-256 provenance are in `source/`. No gameplay integration.
